value.rationale: The known triangle incenter spherical-depth question naturally asks for regular tangential polygons. Odd regular polygons are not centrally symmetric, so whether the center depth exceeds one half is a nontrivial geometric question. The theorem fully classifies all side counts, resolves the alternating sign by congruence mod four, gives an exact elementary probability and a positive \(n^{-5}\) leading constant. The universal outer-uniform strip lemma provides structural explanation beyond individual case computations. The older triangular instance and trivial even case are excluded from novelty.
